_ap_world_name_source: world source: lagdotcom/Archipelago, read 2026-08-23 -- worlds/shining_itd/__init__.py has `class SITDWorld(World)` with `game = game_name`, imported `from .constants import game_name`, and worlds/shining_itd/constants.py defines `game_name = "Shining in the Darkness"`
description: The Labyrinth beneath Thornwood as a multiworld.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game - no text copied from the game itself

rom.description: A US/European Shining in the Darkness ROM
rom._description_source: setup guide: "A US/European Shining in the Darkness Rom, probably named `Shining in the Darkness (UE) [!].bin`"
rom._md5_source: world source: worlds/shining_itd/rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- `SITD_UE_HASH = "522b689a1b2f0ea8578fa9d888554b82"`, which the world uses as `hash` on SITDProcedurePatch, i.e. the dump the world itself validates the player's file against.
rom._size_note: Not measured. London reads size 0 as 'unknown' and matches on MD5 alone, which is the stronger check.

emulator.name: BizHawk
emulator._source: setup guide: "Bizhawk: Version 2.7.0 and later are supported."

client.name: Archipelago's BizHawk Client
client._source: SCHEMA rule 1, read from the world itself: lagdotcom/Archipelago worlds/shining_itd/client.py, 2026-08-23 -- `class SITDClient(BizHawkClient)` with `system = "GEN"`. The guide calls it "The built-in Archipelago client". ⚠ Rule 2 is NOT satisfied: no RAM map Plugins/Scripts/games/shining_itd.lua exists yet, so the build refuses this manifest until one is written.

apworld._source: catalog/sheet_links.json, "APWorld" link for Shining in the Darkness. The setup guide does not name a source.

patch._source: world source: worlds/shining_itd/rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- `class SITDProcedurePatch(APProcedurePatch, APTokenMixin)` with `hash = SITD_UE_HASH` and `patch_file_ending = ".apsitd"`. The guide agrees: "Your data file should have a `.apsitd` extension. Double-click on your `.apsitd` file to start your client and start the ROM patch process."

_patch_extension_source: world source: worlds/shining_itd/rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- the file defines no APPatchExtension subclass; patching is APProcedurePatch + APTokenMixin, so the generic steps are correct. Only rom.py was read, which is where catalog/SCHEMA.md locates this answer.
